name: dsh-vrchat-vplay
description: Self-contained VRChat OSC bridge + virtual player for DeepSeek Harness with a local button panel: talk through the chatbox, sense avatar parameters, drive OSC input actions, click VRChat menus through virtual knuckles controllers (bundled dsh_hmd + VMT drivers), control head/body pose, and run the Phase 1 virtual player (perception switch, A* navigation, 3D skeleton monitor, watchdog) with a one-knob mode switch and a read-only doctor.
author: dsh-VRChat-vplay contributors

scripts.test: node tools/plugin-offline-test.mjs && node tools/osc-selftest.mjs && node tools/test_player.mjs
